buttonViaSubpath.note: byte-identical output to the barrel build

scenarios.name: Discover the API from public documentation
scenarios.note: API.md now documents all 56 exported modules (245 export entries), generated from source and CI-checked. The dead docs-site link is removed and replaced with an honest statement. README adds a 'Picking between similar names' table and a Badge-vs-Tag warning. Deducted for: still no hosted/searchable site, API.md and TOKENS.md are not in the tarball, many prop descriptions are empty, and the README describes a rename as '2.0' on a 1.0.15 package.

scenarios.name: Install from npm into a fresh project
scenarios.note: 45s, 99 packages, 0 vulnerabilities, no peer warnings. 98 MB/16,129 files became 17.85 MB/8,495 files: sourcemaps and the CJS copy dropped, files:['dist'] set, deps re-classified and caret-ranged, @types/react demoted to an optional peer. Deducted because dist/icons is 17.36 MB (97% of the package, 8,208 files) and is installed for every consumer.

scenarios.name: Render the first component (time to first pixel)
scenarios.note: Both documented style-loading paths work. dist/index.js now begins with import './index.css', so the app-entry JS import that silently failed in 1.0.14 loads the stylesheet. Button renders rgb(0,156,224), 48px, 8px radius with zero console output. Tailwind v4 is now install step 1 rather than a footnote, and the self-contradictory @source paragraph is gone.

scenarios.name: Build a realistic form
scenarios.note: Controlled state predictable, typechecked first try. Event model unified on onCheckedChange across Checkbox/Radio/Toggle/Rating; SelectTrigger's placeholder shorthand removes the double-placeholder wart. InputText now emits aria-invalid and aria-describedby. Deducted because SelectTrigger's label/error props are wired to nothing, so two sibling field components behave differently.

scenarios.name: Modal / Dialog flow
scenarios.note: Focus moves into the dialog on keyboard open, Tab cycles within it and never escapes, Escape closes and restores focus to the trigger, background siblings are aria-hidden. Controlled and uncontrolled both behave. Only nit: aria-modal is absent (aria-hidden on siblings achieves the practical result).

scenarios.name: Data table
scenarios.note: disabled rows really disable (aria-disabled, data-disabled, pointer-events:none, click produced no state change). sortDirection sets aria-sort, sortable sets aria-sort='none', th carries scope='col', and header content is a real <button> so Enter sorts. The leaked container classes on <tr> are gone.

scenarios.name: Overlay composition (Popover / Tooltip / Tab)
scenarios.note: Popover is now the root like Dialog/Tabs/Tooltip; PopoverPanel is the panel; PopoverRoot is a deprecated alias. PopoverMenu adds role='menu' and arrow-key navigation, asMenuItem adds role='menuitem'. Deducted for: the Tab family's composition error names Radix's TabsTrigger/Tabs, which collide with the library's own legacy Tabs export, and the TooltipProvider requirement is still undocumented in prose.

scenarios.name: Toasts
scenarios.note: toast is now re-exported from the package and documented, so the phantom sonner dependency is gone. Fires into an aria-live='polite' region. Snackbar is documented as a deliberately separate viewport.

scenarios.name: Theming via design tokens
scenarios.note: The README's theming example now names --color-brand and --radius-lg and explains why --primary and --radius look like no-ops. Measured: themed scope gives oklch(0.55 0.2 260)/9999px, the legacy names change nothing (as documented). Dark mode scopes correctly on a nested container. TOKENS.md's stale --primary entry is corrected to the shipped #009ce0.

scenarios.name: Per-instance customization / className override
scenarios.note: tailwind-merge is applied: passing rounded-full removes the library's rounded-lg from the class list entirely rather than racing it in the cascade. Verified on Button (bg, radius, padding), Card (p-8, rounded-none) and InputText's fieldClassName/boxClassName escape hatches.

scenarios.name: TypeScript DX
scenarios.note: Eight deliberate mistakes produced eight precise diagnostics including "Did you mean 'label'?". A nine-file app using ~40 components typechecked clean on the first attempt. @types/react is now an optional peer, removing the duplicate-types hazard. The documented claim that <Popover className> no longer typechecks holds. Deducted because only 2 of 5 duplicate families carry @deprecated, and the Popover migration error does not name PopoverPanel as the fix.

scenarios.name: Accessibility defaults
scenarios.note: Fixed: dialog focus trap and restore, aria-invalid/aria-describedby on InputText, aria-sort, th scope, keyboard-operable sort headers, real disabled rows, menu roles on PopoverMenu, Button loading fires 0 submits when activated, and all 41 hardcoded Korean strings are gone (Spinner announces 'Loading'). Remaining: SelectTrigger has no visible focus indicator (focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:outline-none) — a WCAG 2.4.7 failure — its label is not associated and its error sets no aria-invalid/aria-describedby; Dialog omits aria-modal; Toggle has no label prop.

scenarios.name: Error recovery / mistake tolerance
scenarios.note: Invalid variant, wrong prop type, misspelled prop and wrong import casing all produce precise TypeScript errors. Orphan overlay parts throw accurate messages for Popover, Select and Tooltip. Forgetting the stylesheet is no longer possible through the barrel (the JS entry imports the CSS). Deducted for: Tab's error names TabsTrigger/Tabs, the subpath import path is still a silent unstyled failure (documented with a warning), and require() reports ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED rather than saying the package is ESM-only.

scenarios.name: Realistic application screen
scenarios.note: A full dashboard (Sidebar, stat Cards, sorted Table, Dialog, Tag, Avatar, Spinner, toasts) composed without fighting the library and typechecked first try. Tag renders 'Enterprise' un-clipped at 74px, which is the 1.0.14 Badge trap now resolved by documentation. Zero console errors.

scenarios.name: Next.js App Router / SSR
scenarios.note: The 1.0.14 'createContext is not a function' crash is gone. A Server Component page using Button, Card and a Table with sortDirection and a disabled row builds, prerenders statically and renders styled. Bisected: Button, Card, Table, Spinner, Avatar, Badge, Divider, Skeleton, Empty, Label and Progress all pass; Tag, Chip and Pagination fail with 'Event handlers cannot be passed to Client Component props'. Client components hydrate with zero warnings and are fully interactive. The 'use client' requirement remains entirely undocumented.

scenarios.name: Packaging, build output, tree-shaking
scenarios.note: One Button costs +23.8 kB raw / +7.9 kB gzip over a bare React app (was +783 kB / +229 kB). The bundle contains zero occurrences of lexical, sonner, date-fns, embla, carousel or daypicker. Barrel and subpath imports produce byte-identical output; the subpath's benefit is dev-server module count (22 vs 1,511 transformed). ESM-only, sideEffects declared, no sourcemaps, no CJS duplicate. Deducted only for the 17.36 MB icon payload every consumer installs.

criticalBlockers: Rendering Tag, Chip or Pagination in a React Server Component fails `next build` with 'Event handlers cannot be passed to Client Component props', and the required 'use client' boundary is undocumented. The README's own component guide recommends Tag and Chip.
severeNonBlocking: SelectTrigger has no visible focus indicator (focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:outline-none) — a WCAG 2.1 SC 2.4.7 failure on a core form control.
SelectTrigger's label prop is not programmatically associated and its error prop sets no aria-invalid/aria-describedby, while the identical-looking InputText props were fixed this release.
A breaking rename (Popover: panel -> root) shipped in a patch release and is documented in both README and API.md as 'Renamed in 2.0'.

evaluatorNotes: Both test applications were created from scratch under ui-package-dx-evaluation/v2/. No node_modules tree, lockfile, build output or screenshot from the 1.0.14 run was reused. The installed tarball's integrity hash was checked against the registry metadata for 1.0.15.

No issue is marked fixed on the basis of documentation or inference. Every entry in resolvedFromPreviousRun was re-verified by writing code against the installed package and running it in a browser or a production build.

Package internals were inspected only after a failure was observed, to establish root cause — as the evaluation protocol permits. The initial pass used npm metadata, README, API.md, TOKENS.md and public type declarations only.

Two failures were caused by evaluator error and are excluded from scoring: an error boundary that reported 'NO ERROR' because it never rendered its children, and a Radio rendered outside a RadioGroup with a non-existent name prop. Both were fixed and re-run.
